title: fit_col counts chars not display columns: wide characters break layout
description: fit_col() in ui.rs counts char count (chars().count()) against max, but max is a column count. Unicode wide characters (CJK, emoji) occupy 2 terminal columns each. A string like '你好' has 2 chars but 4 display columns. fit_col('你好ABC', 4) would return '你好A…' (4 chars output), but that renders as 7 columns (2+2+1+…=6), overflowing the target. The function uses char-counting not UnicodeWidthChar::width() for its loop guard and truncation. Since fit_col is exported pub but not currently called in the render path (draw_chat_list and draw_messages just pass raw strings), this is a latent bug if fit_col is ever used in a width-bounded context with wide characters. However the function doc says 'display characters' implying char count, which is internally consistent even if misleading.
